lead.title: llama.cpp fixes a Vulkan bug that silently corrupted tokens on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs
lead.summary: Release b10677 fixes a missing view-alias dependency in ggml_vk_graph_optimize that reordered aliased reads and writes, producing silently wrong tokens, run-to-run output changes, and invalid speculative-decoding acceptance. It hits Qwen3.8's recurrent state hardest; CUDA was unaffected. If you run Vulkan builds, update now.

top_stories.title: llama.cpp OpenVINO backend gains Whisper support, Qwen3.5 on Intel NPUs
top_stories.summary: Release b10672 updates the OpenVINO backend to OV 2026.3.1, adds Whisper and Qwen3.5 inference on Intel NPUs, and fuses IM2COL+MatMul convolutions.

top_stories.title: Fetchgate audits the official MCP registry: 15,329 servers probed
top_stories.summary: A read-only tools/list sweep against every remote URL in the official MCP registry found 54% answering, 29% of live servers running two operators, zero textbook tool-poisoning attacks, and 47 hosts telling the model things nobody should.

top_stories.title: AI image generation on a $1 RP2350 microcontroller
top_stories.summary: A tiny diffusion transformer running on an RP2350 microcontroller generates 128x128 images of human faces, pushing generative AI to the extreme edge of local hardware.

top_stories.title: Conduct ships open-source guardrails for LLM and MCP tool calls
top_stories.summary: Conduct Guard is AI-agent governance with signed policies, a verified chain, fail-closed defaults, an LLM proxy router, and 20+ compliance packs — topping the day's Show HN on August 28.

items.title: Forth MCP gives remote AI clients access to your local MCP servers
items.summary: A hosted relay lets Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client reach local, NAT'd, or firewalled MCP servers without port forwarding or VPNs — one lightweight connector install.

items.title: mcp-session-bridge drives the browser you're already signed into via MCP
items.summary: An MCP server with 20 standalone tools (99 with the free T3rnel extension) that operates the user's existing signed-in browser session over local stdio, with nothing hosted.

items.title: Agentctl brings Terraform-style declarative config to agent harnesses
items.summary: A tool for defining agent harness setups declaratively — 'Terraform for your agent harnesses' — launched on Show HN August 28.

items.title: Leiolai pays users for the compute their devices provide to AI inference
items.summary: A distributed-inference app that runs models across devices people already own instead of data centers — iPhone/Android, free to use, with leiolai-1 offering an 11M-token context via an OpenAI-compatible API.

items.title: LLM Inference Calculator estimates VRAM, latency, and throughput
items.summary: A free web tool for estimating VRAM requirements, latency, and throughput for LLM inference configurations, posted to Show HN August 28.
